info.cls_name: 人文藝術與社會經典教育
info.cls_ename: Humanities & arts and classical education of social science

description.describe_ch: 本課程內容的產生，是由與課學生採集、記錄其口述個人生命事件，或田調社區、傳說故事，因為只有生命可以抵達另一個人的生命。因此學生從聆聽故事開始，投入他人的生命；再經由即興集體創作的方法，結合面具、物件或傀儡等，與回收材料與現成物件對話，以「說演劇場」的形式，也讓這些媒材成為生命故事的載體。課程的另一特色是藉由年輕學子同台演出，由相互搬演與觀看，完成社群的交流，增加探索的觸角與產生匯聚的功能。
description.describe_eh:
The content of this course is generated by the students who collect and record their oral life events, or to tune the community and legends, because only life can reach the life of another person.
Therefore, students begin to listen to the story and invest in the lives of others; and then through the method of impromptu collective creation, combined with masks, objects or shackles, and dialogue with recycled materials and ready-made objects, in the form of "storytelling theater", also let these media Become the carrier of life stories.
Another feature of the course is that the young students will perform on the same stage, and they will interact and watch each other to complete the communication of the community, increase the exploration of the tentacles and the function of gathering.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1同學參與肢體課程活動,態度須友好，表達善意。例如:勿隨意碰觸他人身體或言語輕忽
2同學之間討論議題,彼此間必須尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經驗、背景和觀點。例如:勿大聲喧嘩,斥責他人言論
3為達成期末呈現的共同目標，要注重團隊合作精神，溝通能力。
*對課堂規則有疑義可及時提出,予以解決後,不可違反。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Students participating in physical education activities must be friendly and express goodwill. For example: Don’t touch other people’s bodies or be disrespectful with words
2. When students discuss topics, they must respect and appreciate each student’s personal experience, background, and viewpoints. For example: Don’t make loud noises or criticize other people’s comments
3. In order to achieve the common goal presented at the end of the period, we must focus on teamwork spirit and communication skills.
*If you have any questions about the classroom rules, you can raise them in time. After they are resolved, they must not be violated.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.建立友善，互惠，共學平台。
2.以團體達成目標為第一要務；個人參與態度很重要。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Establish a friendly, reciprocal and mutual learning platform.
2. The first priority is to achieve the group's goals; personal participation attitude is very important.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
綜合說明
期末呈現，同學執行“主題”相關寫作或資料蒐集任務，完成與演出內容需要的書面作業；另為專題實作演出思考需要服裝、物件。老師彙整學生文字資料，撰寫原創劇本，無剽竊他人作品之虞；演出所需品項，皆為學生自行產出，或製作。皆在合法規範下進行呈現必要事務。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: At the end of the semester, students will perform writing or data collection tasks related to the "theme" and complete written assignments related to the content of the performance; they will also think about the costumes and objects needed for the thematic performance. The teacher compiles students' written materials and writes original scripts, without the risk of plagiarizing other people's works; all items required for the performance are produced or produced by the students themselves. All necessary matters are carried out under legal regulations.
